description: Safe administration of intramuscular, intravenous, or subcutaneous injections by a qualified nurse while following proper aseptic techniques and monitoring for immediate adverse reactions.
Professional wound assessment, cleaning, dressing, and infection prevention to promote faster healing and ensure proper wound management.
Administration of intravenous fluids or prescribed medications with continuous monitoring to ensure patient safety and proper infusion.
Dedicated in-home care for senior citizens, including assistance with mobility, hygiene, meals, medication reminders, and companionship during a 12-hour shift.
Comprehensive care for bedridden patients, including repositioning, hygiene assistance, feeding support, vital monitoring, and pressure sore prevention during a 12-hour shift.
Specialized nursing care following surgery, including wound monitoring, pain management support, medication administration, and recovery assessment.
Routine catheter maintenance, cleaning, replacement assistance when required, and monitoring to reduce the risk of infection and ensure patient comfort.
Expert tracheostomy cleaning, suctioning, tube care, and airway management performed by trained nursing professionals to maintain respiratory health.
Safe administration of nutrition and prescribed feeds through a Ryle's tube with proper hygiene, positioning, and monitoring for complications.
Accurate insulin administration as prescribed, along with blood glucose monitoring guidance and patient safety checks.
Timely administration of prescribed medications while ensuring correct dosage, route, patient safety, and documentation.

Compassionate nursing care focused on improving comfort and quality of life for patients with serious illnesses through symptom management, emotional support, and personalized care during a 12-hour shift.
